prompt: Objective: cut a hospital's supply costs. What you've learned: supply costs rose 18% with flat patient volume. Latest finding: prices paid for the top 20 items are 15% above contract prices. What is the best next step?

options.text: Check patient volumes in more detail
options.feedback: That has already been answered. Build on what you know.

options.text: Look at the hospital's parking revenue for more context on the business
options.feedback: That is off the objective. It won't help answer the client's question.

options.text: Find out why purchases are off-contract
options.feedback: Right. The gap between paid and contract prices is the lever. Next is why it happens and what it is worth.

options.text: Recommend switching to a new supplier
options.feedback: That jumps to a solution before the analysis supports it.

explanation: The gap between paid and contract prices is the lever. Next is why it happens and what it is worth.
